analysis_cirs.ac:
* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - Single Phase Full Wave (Transformer) Rectifier
* Auto-grounded net 0 due to GND:pin
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
.model Dmodel D(Is=3.17e-05 n=1.373 Rs=0.051 Cjo=1.6e-10 Tt=0 Bv=100 Ibv=1e-06)
* --- Transformer (parametric, series-R + core loss) ---
.subckt Xfmr P1 P2 S1 S2 params: Lm=100u Ns=3.6 K=0.99 Rwp=0.5 Rws=0.1 Rcore=1e6 Cww=0
Rwp  P1  P1a {Rwp}
Rws  S1  S1a {Rws}
Lp   P1a P2  {Lm}
Ls   S1a S2  {Lm*Ns*Ns}
K1   Lp  Ls  {K}
Rcore P1a P2 {Rcore}
Cww  P1a S1a {Cww}
.ends Xfmr

VAC VAC_src n5 SIN(0 24 160)
RVAC_series VAC_src n4 0.001
VR_PRI_SENSE n6 n_R_PRI_sense 0
R_PRI n_R_PRI_sense n4 0.001
VTX_SENSE_PRI n5 n_TX_p1_sense 0
VTX_SENSE_SEC n7 n_TX_s1_sense 0
XTX n_TX_p1_sense n6 n_TX_s1_sense 0 Xfmr Lm=0.01 Ns=1 K=1 Rwp=0.5 Rws=0.1 Rcore=1e+06 Cww=0
VR_SEC_SENSE n2 n_R_SEC_sense 0
R_SEC n_R_SEC_sense n7 0.001
VD1_SENSE n1 n_D1_sense 0
RD1_SENSE_DAMP n_D1_sense n_D1_damp 0.001
D1 n_D1_damp n2 Dmodel
VD2_SENSE n1 n_D2_sense 0
RD2_SENSE_DAMP n_D2_sense n_D2_damp 0.001
D2 n_D2_damp 0 Dmodel
VD3_SENSE n2 n_D3_sense 0
RD3_SENSE_DAMP n_D3_sense n_D3_damp 0.001
D3 n_D3_damp n3 Dmodel
VD4_SENSE 0 n_D4_sense 0
RD4_SENSE_DAMP n_D4_sense n_D4_damp 0.001
D4 n_D4_damp n3 Dmodel
VR_LOAD_SENSE n3 n_R_LOAD_sense 0
R_LOAD n_R_LOAD_sense n1 9
VC_OUT_SENSE n3 n_C_OUT_sense 0
C_OUT n_C_OUT_sense n1 0.0022

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc

* Transient Requirement tr_single_phase_fw: Verify full wave rectification via isolated transformer.
tran 1e-06 0.1 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
let Vout_avg_diff = v(n3) - v(n1)
meas tran Vout_avg avg Vout_avg_diff from=0.08 to=0.1
print Vout_avg
let VOUT_csv_diff = v(n3) - v(n1)
wrdata time_series/tr_single_phase_fw_VOUT.csv VOUT_csv_diff
let v_R_PRI_auto = v(n6) - v(n4)
wrdata time_series/V_R_PRI.csv v_R_PRI_auto
wrdata time_series/I_R_PRI.csv i(VR_PRI_SENSE)
let v_TX_auto = v(n5) - v(n6)
wrdata time_series/V_TX.csv v_TX_auto
wrdata time_series/I_TX_pri.csv i(VTX_SENSE_PRI)
wrdata time_series/I_TX_sec.csv i(VTX_SENSE_SEC)
wrdata time_series/I_TX.csv i(VTX_SENSE_PRI)
let v_R_SEC_auto = v(n2) - v(n7)
wrdata time_series/V_R_SEC.csv v_R_SEC_auto
wrdata time_series/I_R_SEC.csv i(VR_SEC_SENSE)
let v_D1_auto = v(n1) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_D1.csv v_D1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D1.csv i(VD1_SENSE)
let v_D2_auto = v(n1)
wrdata time_series/V_D2.csv v_D2_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D2.csv i(VD2_SENSE)
let v_D3_auto = v(n2) - v(n3)
wrdata time_series/V_D3.csv v_D3_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D3.csv i(VD3_SENSE)
let v_D4_auto = 0 - v(n3)
wrdata time_series/V_D4.csv v_D4_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D4.csv i(VD4_SENSE)
let v_R_LOAD_auto = v(n3) - v(n1)
wrdata time_series/V_R_LOAD.csv v_R_LOAD_auto
wrdata time_series/I_R_LOAD.csv i(VR_LOAD_SENSE)
let v_C_OUT_auto = v(n3) - v(n1)
wrdata time_series/V_C_OUT.csv v_C_OUT_auto
wrdata time_series/I_C_OUT.csv i(VC_OUT_SENSE)
plot VOUT_csv_diff title 'tr_single_phase_fw_VOUT'
plot v_R_PRI_auto title 'V_R_PRI'
plot i(VR_PRI_SENSE) title 'I_R_PRI'
plot v_TX_auto title 'V_TX'
plot i(VTX_SENSE_PRI) title 'I_TX_pri'
plot i(VTX_SENSE_SEC) title 'I_TX_sec'
plot i(VTX_SENSE_PRI) title 'I_TX'
plot v_R_SEC_auto title 'V_R_SEC'
plot i(VR_SEC_SENSE) title 'I_R_SEC'
plot v_D1_auto title 'V_D1'
plot i(VD1_SENSE) title 'I_D1'
plot v_D2_auto title 'V_D2'
plot i(VD2_SENSE) title 'I_D2'
plot v_D3_auto title 'V_D3'
